name: RetNet · Retention
tagline: Retain memory across several decay timescales.
description: Different attention heads use different fixed decay rates. Retention state and positional structure preserve historical information. Per-head RMSNorm replaces the paper’s GroupNorm to fit the common backbone.
paperTitle: Retentive Network: A Successor to Transformer for Large Language Models
mechanism: Head-specific fixed decay rates for the retention state
Rotary positional structure and an output gate
Per-head RMSNorm; trained with FLA chunk kernels with FP32 state
limitations: Normalization differs from the original paper, so this is a native adaptation. An efficient generation cache is not provided.
